cues.zh: 那么，开发者呢？我们一直在努力想出一个解决方案，
cues.en: Now, what about developers? We have been trying to come up with a solution

cues.zh: 来扩展 iPhone 的能力，让开发者能为它编写出色的应用，
cues.en: to expand the capabilities of iPhone by allowing developers to write great apps for it,

cues.zh: 同时保持 iPhone 的可靠与安全。我们想出了一个非常漂亮的解决方案。
cues.en: and yet keep the iPhone reliable and secure. And we’ve come up with a very sweet solution.
Let me tell you about it.

cues.zh: 我们找到了一种为移动设备创建应用的创新方式，
cues.en: So, we've got an innovative new way to create applications for mobile devices,

cues.zh: 非常创新，而这一切都基于 iPhone 内置了完整的 Safari。
cues.en: really innovative, and it's all based on the fact that iPhone has the full Safari inside.

cues.zh: 完整的 Safari 引擎就在 iPhone 里面，这赋予了我们强大的能力，
cues.en: The full Safari engine is inside of iPhone and it gives us tremendous capability,

cues.zh: 超越了迄今为止任何移动设备，因此你可以编写
cues.en: more than there's ever been in a mobile device to this date, and so you can write

cues.zh: 出色的 Web 2.0 和 Ajax 应用，外观和行为都与 iPhone 上的应用一模一样！
cues.en: amazing Web 2.0 and Ajax apps that look exactly and behave exactly like apps on the iPhone!

cues.zh: 而且这些应用能与 iPhone 的服务完美集成：
cues.en: And these apps can integrate perfectly with iPhone services:

cues.zh: 它们可以打电话、发邮件、在 Google Maps 上查找位置。你
cues.en: they can make a call, they can send an email, they can look up a location on Google Maps. After you

cues.zh: 写完它们后，就能即时分发。你不必担心分发问题：
cues.en: write them, you have instant distribution. You don't have to worry about distribution:

cues.zh: 只需把它们放到你的互联网服务器上。而且更新非常容易：只需更改
cues.en: just put them on your internet server. And they're really easy to update: just change

cues.zh: 你自己服务器上的代码，而不必经历那套非常复杂的更新流程。
cues.en: the code on your own server, rather than having to go through this really complex update process.

cues.zh: 它们的安全性与你在亚马逊或银行进行交易时的安全级别相同，
cues.en: They're secured with the same kind of security you'd use for transactions with Amazon, or a bank,

cues.zh: 并且能在 iPhone 上安全运行，绝不会损害其可靠性或安全性。
cues.en: and they run securely on the iPhone so they don't compromise its reliability or security.

cues.zh: 更绝的是：根本不需要 SDK！只要你懂得如何
cues.en: And guess what: there's no SDK! You've got everything you need, if you know how to write apps

cues.zh: 运用最前沿的 Web 标准来开发，现在就能为 iPhone 打造出惊艳的应用。
cues.en: using the most modern web standards, to write amazing apps for the iPhone today.

cues.zh: 6 月 29 日即可正式上线。
cues.en: You can go live on June 29.
